query: INSERT INTO whatsapp_msg_secrets (account_id, chat, sender, msg_id, secret, expires_at, message_ts) SELECT $1, * FROM UNNEST($2::TEXT[], $3::TEXT[], $4::TEXT[], $5::BYTEA[], $6::BIGINT[], $7::BIGINT[]) ON CONFLICT (account_id, chat, sender, msg_id) DO UPDATE SET secret = EXCLUDED.secret, expires_at = CASE WHEN whatsapp_msg_secrets.expires_at = 0 OR EXCLUDED.expires_at = 0 THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(whatsapp_msg_secrets.expires_at, EXCLUDED.expires_at) END, message_ts = GREATEST(whatsapp_msg_secrets.message_ts, EXCLUDED.message_ts)
